provenance: Mirror of OpenAI 'Sharing AI progress in mathematics' (2026-10-06): ~4000 problems attempted, 722 manuscripts published, 3 later retracted (repo now lists 719 across 372 result families). Pipeline modeled: attempt -> machine-checkable certificate -> independent verification -> retraction accounting. APEDP-X variant reports verified/failed/unavailable/unsupported; it never marks a task verified without a checker certificate.

problems.name: Goldbach conjecture over even integers in [4, 2000000]
problems.checker: exhaustive witness certificate: every even n must have a prime pair
problems.claim_ceiling: C2_PREDICTIVE (finite range only; universal claim abstains)

problems.name: Riemann zeta zero discovery + calibration gate (T = 60)
problems.claim_ceiling: finite-range numerics only; certified zero count deliberately unresolved (S(T) remainder)

problems.name: Planck spectral density: exact Riccati ODE recovery
problems.checker: recomputed jet residual on the raw data + exact-recovery flag + plate snapshot
problems.claim_ceiling: exact recovery of a rational ODE on the fitted family

problems.name: Harmonic oscillator: exact 2nd-order ODE recovery (y'' = -4y)
problems.checker: recomputed jet RMSE (must be < 1e-12) + integrated trajectory R2
problems.claim_ceiling: exact recovery of a linear constant-coefficient ODE

problems.name: Trigonometric family exact recovery: sin(2x) and 2cos(1.3x)
problems.engine: native GA (genetic.rs) with trig template seeding + Powell polish
problems.checker: recomputed MSE on the training grid (must be < 1e-12)
problems.claim_ceiling: exact recovery within the seeded trig grammar

problems.name: Burgers equation: frozen-coefficient transfer to holdout window
problems.checker: frozen-coefficient residual R2 recomputation (no re-fit) + coefficient tolerances
problems.conditional_on: rime_pde_discover_json binding present in the installed kernel extension (pending concurrent-session commit)

problems.name: Lean formalization of a discovered law
problems.reason: Per-result templated Lean files exist in-tree (14+ under apedp_dyn/lean_formal/), but there is no automated at-scale formalization pipeline and no Lean toolchain wired into this sandbox.

problems.name: Quasi-Riemann hypothesis variant (OpenAI headline, Oct 2026)
problems.reason: Requires proof construction and literature novelty. APEDP-X can numerically certify zero locations on a finite range (NT-2) but has no proof-search engine and no originality adjudication.

problems.name: Partial results on the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture
problems.reason: No algebraic-geometry engine, no elliptic-curve machinery, no proof-level output path.

problems.name: Partial results on the Hodge conjecture
problems.reason: No algebraic-geometry engine, no cohomology constructions, no proof-level output path.

problems.name: Kakeya conjecture extension to R^4
problems.reason: Proof-level combinatorial/geometric argument required; outside the ODE/PDE-law and finite-certificate engines.

problems.name: Asymptotic algorithmic advances (multiplication exponent, Fourier transform)
problems.reason: No asymptotic lower-bound or complexity-analysis machinery; the GA recovers closed-form laws, it does not construct asymptotically improved algorithms.

problems.name: Navier-Stokes global regularity discussion
problems.reason: APEDP-X discovers and transfers PDE coefficient laws (PDE-1) on finite grids; global regularity is a proof obligation it cannot state.

problems.name: Autonomous 719-manuscript throughput with retraction accounting
problems.reason: APEDP-X is single-problem and human-in-the-loop: one registry entry per engine invocation, scarce holdout budget, no autonomous multi-thousand-problem pipeline. This sandbox runs ~6 checks per invocation, not ~4000.
